name: marksure-platform
description: MarkSure - Government OIML R-76 Test Report & Digital Passport System for Non-Automatic Weighing Instruments

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')){ fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true}); }"
scripts.build:client: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:netlify: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
